description: Open an image, inspect it, run engine commands and save the result.

identity.goal: Complete the edit image use case of photocraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the photocraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `photocraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced photocraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `photocraft_doc_open`, `photocraft_doc_inspect`, `photocraft_command_list`, `photocraft_command_run`, `photocraft_doc_save`. Steps: (1) Open the file and read the layer tree. (2) Run the engine commands in one batch where possible. (3) Save in the native format unless another format is requested. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace photocraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
